Audit M551-P1-03: both success and failure receipts bind live runner, VCS, foundry V/DB/manifest, source-static/candidate/hammer/release/final-hammer, frozen sources and failure provenance SHAs.
Audit M551-P2-01: old partial is checked as exactly eight plain regular names and all eight M544 SHAs twice before mkdir.
Prove every ordinary post-mkdir failure is double sealed, and an unexpected unsealed zero exit becomes a failure rc rather than a PASS exit.
Prove the new result path, candidate-hammer review, launch_now=true release and final-release-hammer review are absent and launch_now=false remains effective.
claim_boundary: A PASS is source-static only. It establishes no functional VCS, RTL verification, recurrence, speedup, PPA, energy, system or paper-headline claim and still requires the remaining three release gates.
